newsitem.title: USA: Starbucks sees 390 store openings in FY98.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks sees 390 store openings in FY98.

text.p: Starbucks Corp, operator of a large chain of upscale coffee shops, Thursday announced plans to open at least 350 new stores in North America and 40 in Pacific Rim countries during fiscal 1998.

Earlier, Starbucks reported earnings for fiscal 1997's third quarter ended June 29. The company produced net income of $0.18 a share on sales of $242 million versus $0.12 a share on sales of $177 million last year.

In the 39 weeks ended June 29, Starbucks opened 254 retail stores and licensees opened 13 stores in North America. It ended the period with 1,183 company-operated retail stores and 87 licensed stores in North America. Licensees operate two stores in Hawaii.
Overseas licensees operate seven retail stores in Tokyo and two in Singapore.
